title: Paired user-story and acceptance-test assignments
summary: Students transform social-media user feedback into user stories in two individual assignments: first without AI, then with ChatGPT 3.5. For the AI-assisted task they create one prompt per story, include context and INVEST criteria, re-prompt as needed, and edit the output.
